name: gaussian-splat
title: Gaussian splats
about: A photoscanned statue shown the way phone and drone scans are shown on the web: as 540k soft coloured splats, with a sweeping reveal. Drop your own .spz, .ply or .splat capture to look around it.
aboutKo: 폰이나 드론으로 찍은 3D 스캔을 웹에 올리는 방식 그대로예요. 사진으로 스캔한 석상을 54만 개의 부드러운 점(스플랫)으로 보여 줘요. 처음에 스르륵 드러나는 효과가 있고, 내 스캔 파일(.spz, .ply, .splat)을 끌어다 놓으면 바로 둘러볼 수 있어요.
prompt: Show a 3D scan as Gaussian splats on a web page with a magic reveal effect, let me orbit around it, and let me drop my own phone scan file to view it.
promptKo: 내가 폰으로 찍은 3D 스캔을 웹에서 둘러보게 해 줘. 가우시안 스플랫으로 보여 주고, 처음엔 마법처럼 나타나게 해 줘. 내 파일을 끌어다 놓으면 바로 보여 주고.

sources.name: Spark by World Labs (@sparkjsdev/spark 2.4.0)
sources.what: the splat renderer (lib/spark/spark.module.min.js), constructSplats from the procedural-splats example, the Magic reveal from the splat-reveal-effects example

sources.name: Poly Haven, Gothic Statue
sources.what: the photoscan the statue splats are sampled from (assets/gothic_statue.*, texture resized to 1k)

replaces: Spark's own demo captures are not used here; the splats are made in the browser from a CC0 photoscan.
